senses.gloss: (b. h. Nif.; cmp. next w.) to bend, twist, plait.—Part. pass. שָׂקוּד; f. שְׂקוּדָה (cmp. שְׁבֶשְׁתָּא) confused, mistaken.
units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:42">Lam. R. to I, 14</cite> (ref. to <he>נשקד</he>, <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:42">ib.</cite>) <he>ש׳ הייתי מעונותי וכ׳</he> I was in error as to my sins, I thought that he would forgive me all my sins, when I heard that my verdict was torn up.
